description: Per-model price summary of in-stock listings right now: count and min / median / max (JPY and USD), broken down by shop and by normalized condition grade, plus the cheapest listing. Watches are grouped by brand + reference number, instruments by brand + model code, model trains by maker + product code. Use keywords to stay fast (~1–4 min).

brands.description: Exact brand names, e.g. ["Leica", "Nikon"], ["Rolex", "Grand Seiko"] ["Fender Japan", "Gibson"] (instruments: Fender is split into Fender Japan / Fender USA / Fender Mexico / Fender) or ["KATO", "TOMIX", "MicroAce"] (model trains).

grades.description: Normalized condition grades of the chosen market, best to worst. camera: NEW > A > AB+ > AB > AB- > B > ASIS (as is) > PARTS; watch: NEW > UNUSED > SA (like new) > A > AB > B > C > JUNK (not working); ANTIQUE = ungraded antique; instrument: Reverb scale: BRAND_NEW > MINT > EXCELLENT > VERY_GOOD > GOOD > FAIR > POOR > NON_FUNCTIONING (as is / parts); shimokura listings are ungraded; model-train: NEW > MINT > EXCELLENT > VERY_GOOD > GOOD > FAIR > JUNK (as is), plus CUSTOM (modified / painted / kit-built); Pochi A = MINT, A´ = EXCELLENT.

keywords.description: Match any of these in brand + title (case-insensitive, English or Japanese; watches, instruments and model trains also match reference / model / product codes), e.g. ["Leica M6"], ["Grand Seiko", "SBGA211"], ["Fender Japan", "ST57"] or ["KATO", "10-1332"].

market.description: Which market: "camera" (used cameras and lenses) or "watch" (used wristwatches) or "instrument" (used guitars, basses and wind instruments) or "model-train" (used model trains (n, ho)). Default "camera". Shops and grades depend on it — see list_markets.

maxItems.description: Listings to read before summarizing (0 = all; a full read of every shop can take 5–30 min).

sources.description: Shops of the chosen market (default: all of them). camera: fujiya, sanpou, naniwa, hardoff; watch: watchnian, rasin, jackroad, offmall; instrument: shimokura, jguitar, ishibashi, shimamura, ikebe, offmall; model-train: pochi, offmall.

name: price_stats
title: Current price stats per model
